conservative.requirements: 8 favour. You must mark the area to be protected by this benediction with a dove’s feather, scented candle, or other holy symbol. Special: If all intelligent beings in the area join you in invoking the benediction by spending a prepare manoeuvre on their turn immediately preceding your action, reduce the difficulty modifier by {Dc}. Effect: Shallya’s peace descends on the area, which is defined by an existing boundary (such as the threshold of a building or a circle of stones) or is defined by you as you invoke the blessing (such as lighting a ring of candles or walking in a circle). While this blessing is recharging, anyone who commits a violent or hostile action in the area suffers 1 stress and 1 fatigue. This blessing recharges at sunrise.
